notes: reviewed: SpecAirlock stands in for BridgeAirlock (independentLanes() = 2); the hard cap is the starter 1000 tokens, route IN 600/day, route OUT 400/day
inbound / outbound actions pick a route (IN or OUT) and a receiver among the actors, so the fuzzer reaches the limits too

SpecThreats stands in for ThreatRegistry: the setup holds 0xA11CE and queues one held mint of 1 token to it (held[0]); the `unhold` step clears a hold, so releaseHeld can succeed (without it releaseHeld always reverted and its checks were vacuous: found by a deliberately false property)

properties.title: pausing loses nothing
properties.statement: `pause` and `unpause` change no balance and no public state except `paused`: the contract's ETH and every public number, address and flag are the same before and after.
properties.rationale: pause writes paused.
properties.scope: from any state reachable in prover.depth-1 steps; public no-argument getters and the ETH balance (mappings are covered by the AST fact that pause writes only the flag)

properties.title: inbound is stopped while paused
properties.statement: Once `pause` ran, `inbound` reverts for every caller and argument.
properties.rationale: inbound reverts on paused.
properties.scope: any caller and arguments, after a pause from any state reachable in prover.depth-1 steps

properties.title: releaseHeld is stopped while paused

properties.title: inbound: no storage write after an external call
properties.statement: `inbound` makes external calls (mint line 354); every storage write happens before the first call.
properties.rationale: a write after an external call lets the callee re-enter while the state is stale (the classic reentrancy pattern).
properties.scope: static: the solc AST of the function, its modifiers and the internal functions it calls

properties.title: no mint takes the day's inbound total over the hard cap
properties.statement: After any successful inbound or releaseHeld, `totalInToday` is at most `maxDailyLimit`: all routes together never mint more than the hard cap in a day.
properties.rationale: BridgeGuard header: 'a hard cap, maxDailyLimit, over every route's daily limit and over all routes together per day'.

properties.title: no burn takes the day's outbound total over the hard cap
properties.statement: After any successful outbound, `totalOutToday` is at most `maxDailyLimit`.
properties.rationale: the hard cap binds both directions.

properties.title: a mint never takes route IN over its daily limit (or the cap, if lower)
properties.statement: After any successful inbound, route IN's minted-today is at most min(its daily limit, maxDailyLimit).
properties.rationale: 'a daily limit per route and direction, so a hacked bridge can lose at most one day's limit'.

properties.title: a burn never takes route OUT over its daily limit (or the cap, if lower)
properties.statement: After any successful outbound, route OUT's burned-today is at most min(its daily limit, maxDailyLimit).
properties.rationale: per-route, per-direction limits.

properties.title: one inbound mints at most the route's limit
properties.statement: A successful inbound raises the token's supply by at most the route's daily limit (capped).
properties.rationale: the limit is checked before the mint.
